gen-dafont-arkhip-gf-podkova: Arkhip floats its geometric letters well apart, with no swelling anywhere. Podkova has a bookish, traditional warmth, and its broad-mouthed c lets paragraphs unspool comfortably, with fuller bowls than the stark heading.
gen-dafont-arkhip-gf-sanchez: Stark, spaced-out geometry: Arkhip keeps its arms and legs at a constant width. Sanchez is built for reading, with a c opened like calipers, while the heading is built for being looked at.
gen-dafont-bloody-fs-plein: Plein is reliable and clean, with a clear channel leading into each round letter, plus moderate lowercase height. Bloody earns its keep big and short, with huge round bowls.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-quando: Big round bowls, loud and commanding: that is Bloody. Quando slows everything down, with sparse, wide letter spacing and a tall middle zone in every word, giving text a bookish, traditional pace.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-fs-spline-sans: Bushcraft spaces its characters extra wide, with no weight shift on any curve and capitals that barely rise above the lowercase. Spline Sans gives it a contemporary, approachable counterweight.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-fs-synonym: Synonym reads clean and dependable, a plain stripe of constant ink with generous openings in every curve. Bushcraft, expressive and widely spaced, sets the mood, while text below keeps moving smoothly.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-bree-serif: Bree Serif reads literary and refined, its lowercase running to outsized proportions that give text a generous, confident presence. Bushcraft's plain, unmodulated outlines leave the reading feeling lively and unhurried.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-outfit: Wide-spaced curves with no weight shift: that is Bushcraft. Outfit meets it with clean, cable-like strokes that never swell or thin, finishing each curve well before it closes.
gen-dafont-capture-it-bitter: Towering, nearly sealed letters make Capture It hit hard. Bitter opens right up beneath it, its big lowercase eye and see-through s making slab-serif text feel dependable and grounded.
gen-dafont-capture-it-fs-spline-sans: Spline Sans opens its curves wide, with vertical and horizontal strokes of identical weight and a moderate lowercase height. Capture It's towering, nearly sealed letters give it something to push against.
